preconditions.description: The first line of input contains an integer T representing the number of test cases, where T is at least 1.

preconditions.expression: all(isinstance(N, int) and N >= 1 for N in [int(line.strip()) for line in stdin_text.split('\n')[1::3] if line.strip()])
preconditions.description: For each test case, the first line contains an integer N (size of arrays) where N >= 1.

preconditions.expression: all(all(isinstance(x, int) and -10**14 <= x <= 10**14 for x in A) and all(isinstance(x, int) and -10**14 <= x <= 10**14 for x in B) for (A, B) in zip([list(map(int, line.split())) for line in stdin_text.split('\n')[2::3] if line.strip()], [list(map(int, line.split())) for line in stdin_text.split('\n')[3::3] if line.strip()])
preconditions.description: For each test case, the next two lines contain N space-separated integers for arrays A and B, where each element is between -10^14 and 10^14.

preconditions.expression: sum(len(A) for A in [list(map(int, line.split())) for line in stdin_text.split('\n')[2::3] if line.strip()]) <= 2 * 10**5
preconditions.description: The sum of N over all test cases does not exceed 2 * 10^5.

postconditions.description: The output contains exactly T lines, one for each test case.

postconditions.expression: all((lambda A, B, out: (lambda diff: (lambda p, s: (lambda ops: (ops if ops >= 0 else -1)))(max(0, max(p)) + max(0, max(s)) if all(d >= 0 for d in diff) and all(p[i] <= p[i+1] for i in range(len(p)-1)) and all(s[i] <= s[i+1] for i in range(len(s)-1)) else -1))( [B[i]-A[i] for i in range(len(A))], [sum(B[j]-A[j] for j in range(i, len(A))) for i in range(len(A))], [sum(B[j]-A[j] for j in range(0, i+1)) for i in range(len(A))]))(A, B, int(out)) for A, B, out in zip([list(map(int, line.split())) for line in stdin_text.split('\n')[2::3] if line.strip()], [list(map(int, line.split())) for line in stdin_text.split('\n')[3::3] if line.strip()], stdout_lines))
postconditions.description: For each test case, the output is the minimum number of operations to transform A to B using prefix and suffix increments, or -1 if impossible. The calculation is based on the difference array D = B - A. If any D[i] < 0, it's impossible (-1). Otherwise, compute prefix sums of D (p) and suffix sums of D (s). If p is non-decreasing and s is non-decreasing, the answer is max(0, max(p)) + max(0, max(s)); otherwise -1.
